en: A sepia-toned group portrait in front of a stone building entrance with decorative iron doors. The group consists mostly of children in uniform, arranged in several rows, with a few adult men and women standing at the sides and back. Many boys wear dark shirts, shorts, caps, and long socks; a front row of girls or younger children wear light sweaters, dark skirts, ties, and caps. Several caps bear the word 'LAVIS'. One boy at the left holds a drum, and one person at the far left holds a flag.
